class.name: GaeaPriority
class.brief_description: Base class for various types of on-demand [GaeaTask] priority calculations.
class.description: Extending this class allows for organizing [GaeaTask]s in a [GaeaTaskPool] dynamically based on various parameters. For example, see [GaeaBasicPriority] and [GaeaGenerationPriority].

method.name: get_priority_level
method.description: Returns the calculated priority level. What any priority level means relative to another is fundamentally arbitrary.
